brand: Measure Twice · Lens Studio Interactive Preview (SPECS 27, Sunlit Room)

scenes.title: Measure Twice
lines: Lay out a sink cutout on the stone, at real size.
Recorded in the Lens Studio preview only.
Not tried on Spectacles glasses yet.
scenes.say: This is Measure Twice, a Spectacles lens I built for marking a sink cutout on a vanity top. Everything in this video comes from the Lens Studio Interactive Preview. I have not run it on Spectacles glasses yet.

scenes.title: Slab is here
scenes.say: In the preview, a virtual stand-in plays the slab: a 122 by 56 centimeter top, 3 centimeters thick, on a 90 centimeter stand. At the start the only thing shown is one button, Slab is here.

scenes.title: Pick a sink
lines: Three cards on the back edge,
scenes.say: Pinching it shows three sink cards along the back edge, tilted toward me. Each card has the name, an outline drawn at a shared scale, and the size in centimeters and inches.

scenes.title: The cutout, at real size
scenes.say: Pinching a card lays that cutout flat on the slab at real size, with a center cross and a three and a half centimeter faucet hole five centimeters behind it. Four numbers on the stone give the distance to each edge, each with a dimension line.

scenes.title: Too thin turns amber
scenes.say: I drag the outline toward the front. Below the shop minimum, the front number turns amber and the rail fills amber on the stone. While the front or back rail is amber, Lock is dimmed and does nothing.

scenes.title: Center
scenes.say: Center makes left and right equal. When they match within two millimeters, both turn green and read centered.

scenes.title: Shop minimum
scenes.say: The shop minimum slider goes from five to ten centimeters and starts at seven and a half. Moving it to ten turns the nine centimeter front rail amber. The outline does not move.

scenes.title: Lock and trace
scenes.say: Lock freezes the outline, and the same button becomes Unlock. A pulsing marker steps through the four corners and then the faucet hole, one step per Marked. While I trace, the numbers shrink to half size.

scenes.title: Summary
scenes.say: After the fifth mark, a summary line appears inside the outline with the values from lock time, a soft chime plays, and New layout starts over.

scenes.title: Tested with LEAF in the preview
scenes.say: Eight LEAF scenarios drive the lens with real Spectacles Interaction Kit input, and all eight pass in the preview. The reach scenario uses an inverse kinematics arm. It failed on my first layout, so I moved the slab closer and pulled the controls in until each one was within reach.

scenes.title: Not proven yet
lines: Registration and drift on a real slab.
Lines and numbers on polished stone
Pressing the near buttons by touch with the IK hand.
scenes.say: What I have not proven yet: how it holds on a real slab, how the lines read on polished stone under shop lights, voice for marked, which is a button here, and a touch press on the near buttons by the simulated hand. Thanks for watching.
